stages.title: Setup
stages.evidence: project link, config and Playwright present
stages.how: Run qam setup (safe to re-run: it installs only what is missing).

stages.title: Test case store
stages.how: Set QAMASTER_ADO_ORG and QAMASTER_ADO_PROJECT in the app repo .env (token: QAMASTER_ADO_TOKEN or az login), then run qam doctor.

stages.title: Application knowledge
stages.how: Use the AUT-Skill-Builder skill to build or refresh the application knowledge skills.

stages.title: Requirements
stages.how: Ask the user which sprint or dates, then run qam requirements fetch --sprint <name> (or --current-sprint, or --from/--to). Without requirements: qam pipeline mark requirements skipped --note "…".

stages.title: Test cases
stages.how: Ask the user which module to cover, then follow the TestGen skill; the run must pass qam testgen validate.

stages.title: Review
stages.how: Show the person the test cases; only after their yes, run qam review <run>.

stages.title: Publish
stages.how: Run qam publish <run> to preview, and qam publish <run> --apply after the person agrees.

stages.title: Scripts
stages.evidence: 0 feature file(s), 0 traced to test cases
stages.how: Ask the user for the go-ahead, then automate the reviewed test cases with the AutomationCode skill.

stages.title: Script gate
stages.how: Run qam check-scripts and fix every finding.
